descripcion: Tabla comparativa «nosotros vs. los demás». Titular arriba. Debajo, una tabla de 4 filas: a la izquierda el atributo comparado; al centro, una columna alta y elevada en el color de marca, con el producto como encabezado y un check en cada fila; a la derecha, una columna gris con una alternativa genérica sin marca y una cruz en cada fila. Ordenada, lógica y legible en 2 segundos: la columna de la marca gana a simple vista.
reference_style: Clean DTC comparison-table ad: a raised, brand-colored column with the product and check marks next to a muted grey generic column with crosses

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The headline. 2) The highlighted brand column with the product on top, which visually wins (taller, colored, raised). 3) The column of checks against the column of crosses. 4) The row labels.
art_direction.composition_style: Structured three-column table under a centered headline. The table spans about 88% of the canvas width: a row-label column on the left (about 40% of the table width), the brand column in the middle (about 30%) and the generic column on the right (about 30%). The brand column is a tall rounded rectangle that rises higher and drops lower than the generic column and carries the product as its header.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline zone: 6-19% of the canvas height. Column headers (header image + header label): about 22-48%. Rows zone: about 50-93%, divided into 4 equal rows of about 10.5% each, separated by hairline dividers that run across the label column and the generic column. The brand column runs from about 20% to 95% of the canvas height; the generic column from about 26% to 93%. Check and cross icons are centered in their cells. Safe margins of 6% on all sides.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Mostly flat and graphic, with depth only where it helps the brand win: the brand column has a soft drop shadow so it looks raised, and the product has studio light, a crisp highlight and a soft contact shadow. The generic column and its object are flat, low-contrast and greyed out.

layout_summary: Square canvas with a quiet light (or dark) brand-toned background. A bold headline centered at the top. Below, a comparison table with 4 rows: row labels on the left; in the middle, a tall raised brand-colored column topped by the user's product and a short header label, with a check mark in every row; on the right, a shorter flat grey column topped by an unbranded generic alternative object and a short header label, with a cross in every row. Thin hairline dividers separate the rows.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Quiet base that lets the table read cleanly
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Use a light, calm background (off-white tinted with the palette or the lightest brand tone), or the darkest brand tone for dark identities. Flat or with a very soft gradient; it must never compete with the table.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top center, 6-19% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Frames the comparison and states why it matters
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Write the comparison hook of this variation's angle. Keep it short so it fits in max 2 lines.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Middle column of the table, about 30% of the table width, from about 20% to 95% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Visually crowns the user's product as the winner
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Tall rounded rectangle filled with the brand primary color, corner radius about 3% of the canvas, soft drop shadow, visibly taller and more prominent than the generic column.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Header of the brand column, centered on it, about 20-24% of the canvas height and no wider than about 22% of the canvas width (it must stay inside the column's width); its top may break slightly above the column edge for a 3D pop
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, packaging, label and colors), front or 3/4 view, studio-lit, with a soft contact shadow on the column.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right column of the table, about 30% of the table width, from about 26% to 93% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Represents the losing option in a deliberately plain way
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Flat light grey rounded rectangle (dark grey on dark backgrounds), no shadow, clearly less prominent than the brand column.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Header of the generic column, centered on it, about 14-17% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the usual option the product beats
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Show the typical alternative the buyer uses today for this need: a plain generic version of the same product category or the object of the old method. Completely unbranded (no label, no logo, no readable text), desaturated grey tones, flat lighting. Never depict a real competitor brand or packaging.

detected_visual_blocks.position: One icon per row in each column, centered in its cell
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Makes the verdict readable without reading the text
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Brand column: white check marks inside small circles in the brand accent (or green if the palette has no positive color). Generic column: red or dark-grey X marks inside small muted circles. Every icon about 5-6% of the canvas height, identical size and style across rows.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left column of the table, one label per row, left-aligned at the 6% margin; dividers between rows
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names what is being compared in each row
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Four short labels, one per row, vertically centered in the row. Hairline dividers (about 0.2% of the canvas, low-contrast grey) separate the rows across the label and generic columns, passing behind the brand column.

text_layers.text_style: Extra bold sans-serif, each line about 6-7% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, centered, maximum contrast against the background; one key word may use the brand accent
text_layers.guia_texto: Plantea la comparación o declara la diferencia en 4 a 8 palabras (por qué cambiarse o qué hace distinto al producto).

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the top of the brand column, directly below the product, centered
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, about 3-3.5% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered, white or the highest-contrast color on the brand column
text_layers.guia_texto: El nombre del producto o de la marca, máximo 2 palabras, como texto simple (nunca un logo).

text_layers.reference_position: Directly below the generic object, centered in the generic column
text_layers.text_style: Medium weight sans-serif, same size as the brand header, 1 line, centered, mid-grey
text_layers.guia_texto: Cómo se llama la alternativa común, máximo 2 palabras («Otros», «Los demás» o la categoría genérica). Nunca una marca real.

text_layers.text_style: Semi-bold sans-serif, about 3.2-3.8% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, left-aligned, dark on light background (or white on dark)
text_layers.guia_texto: El atributo que más pesa para el ángulo, de 2 a 4 palabras, formulado en positivo para que el check y la cruz se entiendan solos.
Segundo atributo diferencial, de 2 a 4 palabras, en positivo (ventaja de uso, ingrediente, material o resultado).
Tercer atributo, de 2 a 4 palabras, en positivo (durabilidad, comodidad, rapidez, seguridad, etc.).
Cuarto atributo, de 2 a 4 palabras, en positivo; si el ángulo es objeción de precio, aquí va el valor (por ejemplo, rendimiento o costo por uso), nunca una cifra de precio.

mandatory_visual_elements: Tall, raised brand-colored column topped by the user's product
Flat grey generic column topped by an unbranded generic alternative object
Check marks in every row of the brand column and crosses in every row of the generic column
forbidden_additions: Price tags, discount, offer or urgency badges
Trust seals, guarantee or certification badges
Icons other than the check and cross marks
Real competitor brands, logos or recognizable packaging
More than 4 rows or a third compared option
notas_paleta: Paleta de marca aplicada para que la marca «gane»: la columna del producto en el color principal y los checks en el color de acento; la columna genérica, su objeto y las cruces en grises neutros (las cruces pueden ir en rojo apagado). El fondo usa el tono más claro (o el más oscuro) de la paleta para no competir con la tabla.
